## Why

What problem does this solve? Link the issue it closes.

## What changed

Describe the technical approach. Mention any behavior change visible to users.

## Risks

Security, compatibility, performance, lockout or data-loss risks. Write "none" only if you checked.

## How it was tested

Commands you ran and what you observed. State clearly what you did **not** test.

## Dependencies

List any new dependency and justify it. If there is none, write "none".

## Checklist

- [ ] I wrote or fully understand every line of this change and can explain it in review
- [ ] Formatting is clean (`clang-format`, `npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Docs and the threat model are updated if behavior or guarantees changed
- [ ] No private notes, credentials or generated files are included
